exp.role: Customer service adviser, deputy team leader from 2024

cv.name: Owen Price
cv.title: Customer service adviser, deputy team leader

cl.p1: for the last two years I have covered for my team leader whenever she is away. That means allocating work across eight colleagues, running the morning huddle and taking the calls from customers who insist on speaking to “someone senior”. I would now like to take on the role properly.
cl.p2: I have worked in customer service for seven years, mostly on billing and complaints. Last year I led a small project with our IT and billing teams that cut the time to change a payment plan from nine days to three, without anyone reporting to me.
cl.p3: I am currently completing a first-line management course. I would value the chance to talk to you.

letters.label: Stepping up into a first team leader role

cl.p1: five years leading a team of twelve in online retail have taken me through two peak seasons at triple volume and a system change nobody asked for. Staff turnover in my team ended up under five per cent; across the site it was eighteen.
cl.p2: I want to move into manufacturing because order management there sits much closer to production and engineering. One-to-ones, objectives and rota planning are part of my normal week. My notice period is three months.

letters.label: Experienced team leader moving into manufacturing
